# slf4j-ktx (Kotlin 1.9.25)

> Kotlin 1.9.25 compiler plugin that eliminates SLF4J logging boilerplate. Annotate a class with `@Slf4j` and the plugin synthesizes its `Companion` with an internal `log: Logger` property plus `trace`/`debug`/`info`/`warn`/`error × 2` level functions. User class body, supertypes, constructors are never touched. Lazy: `if (log.isXxxEnabled) log.xxx(message())` — lambda skipped when the level is disabled. 1-hop meta-annotation support; Spring integration via a separate Gradle plugin. K1 and K2 both registered; the compiler picks the active frontend. Works with Kotlin 1.9.25, SLF4J 1.7.36+, Java 8+.

- Compiler plugin: Companion-centric synthesis + IR body generation for `log`, `trace/debug/info/warn/error × 2`
- Runtime library `slf4j-ktx-core`: `@Slf4j` annotation + Marker/MDC inline extensions (independent `coreVersion`)
- Gradle plugin: `slf4jKtx { annotation("…") }` DSL — single option for custom trigger FQNs
- Spring Gradle plugin: auto-applies main + pushes six Spring stereotype FQNs as triggers
- Branch `1.9.25-release`; rewrite from the legacy `slf4j-extensions` modules (see CHANGELOG.md)
